title: A ribbon of tiny teeth
hook: A snail can feed without biting like a mammal.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The second panel magnifies a toothed ribbon at a food surface. Many snails use a radula to scrape or process food; radula form and diet vary, and the diagram does not show all species or a real motion sequence.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: Many snails scrape food using a radula. Which structure does the radula resemble in this simplified diagram?
